top_signals.title: Bailey Says Nothing Suggests BOE Edging Toward a Hike
top_signals.summary: “Please do not leave this room thinking that the Bank of England is edging toward a hike because there is nothing in what I said or any of us have said along those lines,” Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey tells reporters after the central bank decided to leave interest rates unchanged on Thursday. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Warsh Presser ‘A Little Bit Rocky,’ Says James Bullard
top_signals.summary: Former St. Louis Fed President James Bullard calls the reaction in the 30-Year US Treasury to Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh’s press conference on Wednesday “nerve wracking” for a central banker. Bullard says Warsh needed to create more optionality in September and that “markets obviously didn’t like this.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows return as Ether funds slip into outflows
top_signals.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $32.1 million in inflows on Wednesday despite Bitcoin dipping below $64,000, ending a four-session outflow streak.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Lower crude oil prices reduced U.S.-Canada energy trade value in 2025
top_signals.summary: The value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau. Energy trade value is the total value of energy imports and exports between two countries and is driven by commodity volumes and prices. Most of the U.S.-Canada trade value is U.S. energy imports from Canada—$111 billion in 2025—rather than from U.S. energy exports to Canada, which totaled $26 billion last year. Crude oil accounts for the largest component of U.S.-Canada energy trade, making up 69% of the total value traded in 2025.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
